symptom: v52 temporary probes against v51 could not produce a promotable content-only repair for frosting-grassland RouteBot. Pure wave-pool probes A, B, D, and E kept RouteBot at 40.0%, above the 10%-35% low-skill target. Trail-hazard probes C and F reduced RouteBot to 20.0% or 30.0%, but C pushed RandomBot to 20.0% and GreedyXpBot to 10.0%, while F pushed RandomBot to 20.0% and GreedyXpBot to 20.0%.
root_cause: The remaining RouteBot issue is not a simple spawn-pressure deficit. Fixed elliptical movement survives when the 210-300 second enemy mix remains readable to the route, but broad enough leave_hazard trail pressure to break the route also changes the seed topology for random movement and XP-seeking policies. The 210-225 Boss-entry window is especially sensitive: it can break RouteBot, but even a 2% weak trail-hazard mix changes RandomBot and GreedyXpBot outcomes.
fix: Do not promote any v52 temporary probe to generated_candidate_patches, generated_candidates, simulated_candidates, playtest_candidates, accepted_content, or Runtime formal content. Stop further weight-only micro-tuning for this repair loop. The next repair should be a narrower, readable route-lane disruption mechanism or event shape that targets repeated fixed-path safety without adding random high-roll wins or suppressing normal XP-seeking economy.
